WITH telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS overall_avg
  FROM telescope_averages
)
SELECT
  ta.telescref,
  ta.avg_modindex,
  ta.avg_modindex - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall_avg,
  ta.avg_modindex / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_group_average
FROM telescope_averages AS ta
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE ta.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg
ORDER BY ratio_to_group_average DESC
LIMIT 10
